option.counterfactual: Every normalized 2-quasitrace on a finite AW*-factor is exhaustive on bounded positive series, even though exhaustivity fails for some normalized 2-quasitraces on other C*-algebras.
option.approach: Audit the passage from an arbitrary nonexhaustive 2-quasitrace to a finite AW*-factor. Identify whether taking an extreme quasitrace or forming its completion can destroy the positive series or its persistent quasitrace values.

options.counterfactual: A faithful normalized 2-quasitrace on a finite AW*-factor can fail exhaustivity: some positive elements have partial sums bounded by 1 while their quasitrace values stay bounded away from zero.
options.approach: Study the supremum of persistent quasitrace increments over arbitrarily long finite positive families. Use spectral compressions of each family's total sum to test whether a positive supremum must equal 1/2.
